verdict.summary: The keepalive now keys dispatch.yml liveness on the exact, non-expired executed-tick artifact while preserving run-age anchoring for every other workflow and the existing live-run guard. The threshold is tied to the floor module and leaves a full tick of slack. The added self-tests execute the extracted production shell body with strict hermetic stubs and assert both disagreement directions between run and marker age, exact-name and expiry handling, live-run precedence, read-failure behavior, unchanged run-anchored legs, and a fresh-fleet control. These tests are non-vacuous and would fail for the pre-change run anchor or the identified weakening mutations. No trust check, permission boundary, or injection-sensitive expansion is weakened.
